Guideline 1.1 - Safety - Objectionable Content

Issue Description

Your app includes content that a reasonable user would find overtly sexual or offensive. Specifically, the app lets users dress the AI character in sexually suggestive outfits and generate images of the character in them.

Next Steps

Remove all objectionable content from your app, including content that can be generated by users, and resubmit for review. Apps with user-generated or AI-generated content must also include the safeguards described in Guideline 1.2.

Resources

- Review the App Review Guidelines, section 1.1.
- Learn more about requirements for apps with user-generated content.
